items.why: It's 1948. “1945” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.
The answer examiners want is: The Hague. “New York” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.
Exact answer: 1945. Estimation gets you near it; only the anchored number survives the exam hall.
